notes.title: 1-Week Update & Roadmap Brief
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Huge thanks for your support and feedback in the first week! 🎉

​​Current Status:​​

​​Stability:​​ No critical game-breaking bugs found!

​​Bug Fixes:​​ First patch is out. ​​We'll keep fixing reported issues​​.

​​Future Major Features:​​
We explored adding ​​Multiplayer/Co-op​​ and a ​​Level Editor​​.

However:
[olist]
They are ​​technically complex​​.

​​Current sales can't support hiring the needed programmer(s)​​.
[/olist]
Therefore:

These features are ​​now on hold​​.

We'll monitor ​​sales over the next month​​.

If sales don't significantly improve by then, ​​they likely won't be developed​​.

​​Rest Assured:​​

Regardless of major features, ​​bug fixes and minor improvements will continue​​.

If major features are unfeasible, active development will conclude. We'll carry the lessons learned into our ​​next game​​.

Thanks for your understanding! We're still listening.



Hua
